title: Termwise lifting with the composite functor factors retained
statement: For categories $I,A,B,C,D$, functors $f:A\to B$, $g:B\to D$, $h:A\to C$, $k:C\to D$, and a natural transformation $t:fg\Rightarrow hk$, define its termwise lift from postcomposition by $f$ then $g$ on $I$-diagrams to postcomposition by $h$ then $k$. It is the standard postcomposition image of $t$, conjugated by the canonical postcomposition-composition isomorphisms. Its component at a diagram $M$ and an object $n$ of $I$ is $t_{M(n)}$.
